cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: A
